create_voxelizer_with_augmentation: create a Voxelizer instance with scale, rotation, and translation augmentation bounds for point cloud data
voxelize_point_cloud: voxelize 3D point cloud coordinates with features and labels using the Voxelizer class
clip_point_cloud_coords: clip point cloud coordinates to a specified bounding box using the Voxelizer clip method
get_transformation_matrix: get the voxelization and rotation transformation matrices from a Voxelizer instance for coordinate transforms
voxelize_temporal_sequences: voxelize a sequence of temporal point clouds with shared augmentation using voxelize_temporal
